translations.web: Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in his father David’s city: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Solomon rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of his father David. And his son Rehoboam reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
